args.meaning: Front-door argv for the staff-socket listener. --socket PATH changes the listener path.

--socket.meaning: Unix-domain socket to create and serve.

exceptionType.meaning: Type of the uncaught startup or serving error as projected by the front door. Normal serving has no finite JSON return; its socket replies are a different protocol.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: Invalid argv or a front-door projection of an uncaught exception.
